response.justification: The candidate is an experienced and versatile senior engineer, but the profile does not match the core mandatory requirements. C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015 plus a university thesis project, versus the required 5–10 years of hands-on C++ — and none of it on a Windows-centric enterprise platform in recent years. There is no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle work (only MySQL/MongoDB listed), and no fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking domain experience; RIDE Capital is retail investment fintech built in Node/TypeScript, which is only tangentially related to capital markets. The strong communication skills, testing discipline, and CI/CD background are genuine assets, but they cannot compensate for the missing primary technical and domain criteria.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering experience with strong testing, TDD, and CI/CD discipline
Proven communication ability through workshops, conference talks, and courses
Systems/low-latency background (DLang, async I/O, high-throughput services) shows solid fundamentals
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ (2014–2015), far below the 5–10 year requirement
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; database work is MongoDB/MySQL
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking / capital markets domain exposure
